RestServiceDefinition.SqlExecute: --Generate the Json for adding a role to a package SELECT r.id AS CatalogId, accesspackage.id AS PackageId, json_object( 'id', '', 'role', json_object( 'id', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 'originId', rr.originid, 'displayName', rr.displayName, 'description', rr.description, 'accessPackageResource', json_object( 'id', r.resources_id, 'description', r.resources_displayName, 'displayName', r.resources_displayName, 'url', 'null', 'originId', r.resources_originId, 'originSystem', 'AadApplication', 'isPendingOnboarding', 'false', -- 'accessPackageResourceEnvironment', 'null', 'attributes', json_array() ), 'originSystem', 'AadApplication', 'roleType', 'null' ), 'scope', json_object( 'displayName', 'Root', 'description', 'Root Scope', 'originId', r.resources_originId, 'originSystem', 'AadApplication', 'roleOriginId', 'null', 'isRootScope', 'true', 'url', 'null' ) ) AS role_json_output FROM accessPackageResources r INNER JOIN accessPackageResourceRoles rr ON r.resources_originId = rr.resource_originId join accessPackage WHERE r.resources_originSystem = 'AadApplication' AND r.resources_originId IN (SELECT id FROM servicePrincipals) AND rr.displayName in (select rolename from businessrole);
